_manifest.attribution: Data aggregated by pdata.world (https://pdata.world) from 8 prediction-market venues; CC BY 4.0; source data © each venue.
_manifest.description: Every event open for trading on the 8 venues pdata tracks, one per line. An event groups the markets of one question; markets-open holds its markets.
_manifest.as_of_note: When this export started. Rows are read over a few minutes; each row's own timestamp says when pdata last wrote it.
_manifest.format: JSON lines: this manifest, then one record per line.

fields.source: Venue: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion or gemini.
fields.id: The venue's event id, unique within source (pdata builds the id of a group event).
fields.title: Event title as the venue publishes it.
fields.categories: pdata topic categories (e.g. Politics, Sports), from rules and AI tagging.
fields.start_date: When the event opened, as the venue reports it (UTC).
fields.end_date: Scheduled close or expiry, as the venue reports it (UTC).
fields.volume: Lifetime trading volume. Venue-reported, in the venue's own unit and not converted across venues: shares for Polymarket and contracts for Kalshi (each pays $1 at resolution), play-money mana for Manifold, and each other venue's figure as it reports it.
fields.volume_24hr: Trading volume over the last 24 hours. Venue-reported, in the venue's own unit and not converted across venues: shares for Polymarket and contracts for Kalshi (each pays $1 at resolution), play-money mana for Manifold, and each other venue's figure as it reports it.
fields.open_interest: Open interest as the venue reports it, in the venue's own unit.
fields.mutually_exclusive: True when exactly one of the event's markets can resolve YES; false when they are independent questions; null when the venue does not say.
fields.market_count: How many markets the event has (for a group event, across its child events).
fields.is_group: True for an event pdata built to group sibling Kalshi events of one matchup.
fields.parent_event_id: The pdata group event this event belongs to, or null.
fields.synthetic: True for an event pdata created to wrap a market the venue lists without one.
fields.updated_at: When pdata last wrote this row (UTC): every fetch from the venue, and again when pdata recomputes a derived field.
fields.url: The event or market's own page on the venue's website; null when it cannot be built.
fields.pdata_url: pdata's page for the event, https://pdata.world/events/{source}/{id}.

_manifest.sample: 500 rows drawn at random from the full file (38,356 rows), an equal share per venue where the venue has enough rows (seed 20261007). The full file, rebuilt nightly: https://api.pdata.world/bulk/events-open-latest.jsonl.gz
